officialSections.title: An opportunity to keep learning
officialSections.text:
Nova Merit Scholarship 2026
Application guidelines
Published 2 February 2026

The Nova Merit Scholarship supports students taking their next step in higher education. These guidelines describe the eligibility, documents and award for the 2026 application cycle.

This is a fictional document created for the Source Lantern sample demo. It is not an application notice from a real organization.

officialSections.title: Who can apply
officialSections.text:
Applicants must be aged 17-25 and be Indian citizens.

Applicants should be enrolled in a recognized undergraduate programme in India. Keep a current enrollment letter and proof of identity ready before completing an application.

officialSections.title: Income and supporting documents
officialSections.text:
Family income must be below INR 6,00,000.

Submit an income certificate issued within the last 6 months.

The income certificate should show the applicant's family income and the issuing authority. Keep a readable copy of the certificate together with identity and enrollment documents.

officialSections.title: Dates and scholarship award
officialSections.text:
The application deadline is 30 November 2026.

The scholarship amount is INR 50,000 per year.

Applicants should confirm the current notice before making plans. The date and award stated here belong to the fictional 2026 application cycle.

officialSections.title: Before you apply
officialSections.text:
Read the complete guidelines and keep the required documents together. If a requirement is unclear, ask the scholarship office for the latest written notice.

Keep a copy of the notice you rely on and record the date you checked it. These sample guidelines do not describe every detail an applicant may need.
